messages:
Ana (AE): Hey team — AcmeCorp POC update. Procurement insists purchase via AWS Marketplace private offer but also requires a PO on the vendor invoice (they want Redwood on invoice). They want a 10-seat commit for 12 months at ~25% off list. Can someone confirm whether marketplace private offers can surface a Redwood invoice with their PO number? Need deal desk + finance input.

Matt (SE): Short answer: private offers support custom pricing, but AWS still invoices the customer. Entitlements can be used to grant seats, but we won't be the billing entity if it's a marketplace order. For a PO on a Redwood invoice we'd need a direct sales contract (Dedicated/private deployment) or act as a reseller.

Julia (Finance): That's correct. Marketplace -> AWS invoices. If customer requires PO on Redwood invoice we'd need to invoice them directly (non-marketplace). 25% on committed spend might be ok but needs review — marketplace fees (~10%) reduce our headroom. How big is the ARR?

Ana (AE): Estimated committed ARR for 12 months ~ $120k. They want invoice terms 30/45 and Redwood name on invoice. Procurement is firm on this.

Charles (Procurement): From their procurement side: PO on vendor invoice is non-negotiable. They refuse cloud vendor invoices via the marketplace for their accounting rules. Is a private contract possible?

Sam (Sales Ops): Deal desk checklist — we need: committed ARR, seat count, requested discount, billing entity, legal signoff, and finance approval. I'll open a request right now. @Julia can you flag if 25% is approvable within margin?

Julia (Finance): 25% on $120k = $30k discount. With marketplace fees (~10%) and infra costs for Dedicated during the POC, we need a short approval cycle. I can provisionally approve pending a cost calc and a signed SOW. ETA 48 hours.

Matt (SE): For the POC we can run on Dedicated so we can invoice them directly if Sales prefers. Tech notes: seat mapping will use our entitlement layer. For initial POC I'll provision 10 seats with quotas and prefix caching to keep costs predictable. Timeline: 2 weeks to stand up.

aws-marketplace-bot: AWS Private Offer created: PO-REQ-88412 — https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/private-offers/PO-REQ-88412 (automated msg)

Ana (AE): Need two clear options to present to Acme:
1) AWS Private Offer (fast, works with their procurement policy but AWS invoices them — no Redwood invoice)
2) Direct Redwood invoice + Dedicated commit (we invoice them, meets PO requirement, longer legal + finance path).
Which one is faster to close?

Sam (Sales Ops): Option 1 is faster to enable technically. Option 2 requires deal desk approval + legal and finance signoff (longer). I created the deal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-2209 and attached the draft pricing sheet.

Julia (Finance): Engineers — quick invoicing mapping that we'll need in billing export for direct invoices:
```json
{"billing_entity":"redwood-inference-inc","customer_po_field":"po_number","lines":[{"sku":"redwood.dedicated.small","qty":10,"unit":"seat","price_usd":1000}],"billing_notes":"terms:NET30"}
```
Make sure the PO number field is exported on invoice PDF.

Matt (SE): POC runtime config (draft) — keep it lean to control costs:
```
instance_type: g4dn.xlarge
capacity: 10
model_variant: r-infer-medium
caching: prefix_kv
rollout: canary
```
Will package as a private deployment manifest if we go direct invoice route.

Ana (AE): Action items: (1) Sam — escalate deal desk + attach PO template (you did, thanks), (2) Julia — confirm margin/approval for 25% (ETA 48h), (3) Matt — prepare POC config + entitlements mapping (ETA 72h), (4) Charles — confirm final procurement stance with Acme (PO on Redwood invoice vs accept AWS invoice) (ETA 24h).

Charles (Procurement): I'll confirm with Acme procurement — they will push to require Redwood invoice. If Redwood can accept PO on invoice, we can proceed on our side. Otherwise they will not sign marketplace PO.

Sam (Sales Ops): Uploaded PO template to DEAL-2209 and set priority=high. Tagged legal for a short addendum if Option 2 chosen.

Ana (AE): Great — keep threads synced. I will update Acme with both options and indicate timelines. Thanks all :thumbsup: :tada:
